annotations.title: Talk to a Nod in text to test it

description: Sends one message to your Nod and returns its answer, using its name, personality and brain. Works right after create_nod, before your owner verifies. Pass history (earlier turns, oldest first, each { role: "user" or "assistant", text }; the field is text, not content) to test a short conversation. Free, up to 30 turns a day in trial and 300 after. It is a text test of the brain and personality; the face and voice run when the Nod is in a room.
name: test_nod
title: Talk to a Nod in text to test it
